headlines.name: MIT discovers that aging weakens the brain’s nighttime cleaning system
headlines.headline: MIT discovers that aging weakens the brain’s nighttime cleaning system
headlines.description: MIT researchers have discovered that the brain’s natural waste-removal system becomes significantly less effective during sleep as people age. The decline is linked to weaker deep-sleep brain waves and changes in blood flow, potentially offering new clues about why aging increases the risk of Alzheimer's disease and dementia.
